methodology: Paired fresh-browser runs. Identical data changes with animation enabled/disabled; three static mount/unmount warmups per browser, CDP GC, then unforced physical-footprint samples from measured mount completion through at least duration+100ms and task settlement. No GC occurs inside this observation window. All browser/renderer/GPU/network process IDs from SystemInfo are included. Baseline is each browser after warmup before measurement. Process-attributed native/DOM/GPU-process memory is included; driver/system allocations not attributed to these processes remain outside this measurement. Peak is a sampled peak after mount, not a continuously observed or during-mount maximum. Settled retainedAfterGC and unmounted afterCyclesBeforeGC/afterCycles are recorded for every run separately from peak.
